scripts.dev: npm run sync:data && npm run dev --workspace @bedashing/web
scripts.dev:web: npm run sync:data && npm run dev --workspace @bedashing/web
scripts.lint:python: python -m ruff check apps/api scripts tests
scripts.format:python: python -m ruff format apps/api scripts tests
scripts.format:check:python: python -m ruff format --check apps/api scripts tests
scripts.lint:ts: npm run lint --workspace @bedashing/data-contract && npm run lint --workspace @bedashing/web
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:ts
scripts.check: npm run validate:data && npm run lint:python && npm run format:check:python && npm run format:check:ts && npm run test && npm run lint:ts && npm run typecheck
